Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with the IDP business code

info.description: Cargo's HTTP API. Every /v1 call carries a bearer token; the tenant and the actor come only from it. A command carries Idempotency-Key (its command id) and, when it changes a resource at a revision, If-Match "n"; it states its business time in occurred_at. Errors are RFC 9457 problems with a business code.
